SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-03: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — Key Elements: Select, ViewDefinition.select, ViewDefinition.select.column, ViewDefinition.select.column.path/name/description. Test these items: select 1..* required and non-empty, column 0..* within each select, column.path 1..1 FHIRPath expression relative to the active context, column.name 1..1 SQL-safe output name, column.description 0..1 markdown retention, multiple select blocks and deterministic column ordering, root and select-relative FHIRPath evaluation contexts. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition logical model: ViewDefinition.select is 1..*, ViewDefinition.select.column.path/name are 1..1 strings, column.name has sql-name invariant ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, and column.description is 0..1 markdown (https://sql-on-fhir.org/ig/2.0.0/StructureDefinition-ViewDefinition-definitions.html).
issues.evidence: Fresh probe .temp/qa/sof_vd03_skeptic_probe.py showed parser/from_dict reject malformed select/column JSON, but direct dataclass boundaries accepted invalid official ViewDefinitions: SQLGenerator().generate(ViewDefinition(resource='Patient', select=[])) returned SELECT NULL WHERE FALSE; ViewDefinition(resource='Patient', select=[]).to_dict() emitted {'select': []}; and ViewDefinition.to_dict() serialized direct Column(path='', name='id'), Column(path='id', name='_bad'), Column(path='id', name='id', description=5), and Column(path='id', name='id', collection='false') instead of rejecting them.
issues.root_cause: Select and column validation was split between strict parser/generator paths and unguarded dataclass serialization. SQLGenerator.generate() validated Select item shapes but did not enforce root ViewDefinition.select 1..* cardinality, and Column.to_dict()/Select.to_dict()/ViewDefinition.to_dict() emitted direct dataclass fields without reusing logical-model validators.
issues.resolution: Added direct root select non-empty validation before SQL generation. Added serializer validation for Column.path/name/description/collection/tag/type, Select column/select/unionAll containers and iterator fields, and ViewDefinition.select non-empty/item shape before emitting official JSON. Added focused parser/generator regression tests.
issues.verified_in: Architect reviewed layered fix and validation: fresh SOF-VD-03 probe PASS; parser/generator pytest 242 passed; ViewDefinition pytest 940 passed; ViewDefinition conformance 134/134; full conformance 2822/2822.
